cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — standing; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing with one foot up on a step; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; A century-old lakeside bathhouse with a dry pebble path cut between two shallow pools — She tests the rhythm of seven skipping stones by laying them out from smallest to largest along the warm coping; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A disused stained-glass workshop with a broad bay window and bins of coloured glass offcuts — She holds two glass offcuts together and projects the colours onto a blank page to choose a visual rhythm for her next verse; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — swimming breaststroke; a night observatory under an open dome — holds her keepsake at chest height; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — seated on the saddle of the parked bike
